label: Claude Haiku 5.5
output:
To: @marco
Replying to: none
Cc: none
Subject: none

Marco, you told me Saturday Desert Palms was done, 14 units, all good. Nobody on this end has one bitting code for that building. Yvette has a tenant in 9B who can't get into her unit, and I can't cut her keys because you never put the codes in the sheet.

This is the Kessler job all over again. I told you in September the codes go in the sheet the same day. I put it out to everybody in August, same day, before you leave the van. No exceptions. Without the codes nobody can rekey, master, or cut a spare for those people, and if somebody loses a key at 2 in the morning we're guessing.

I'm not firing you. You're good with your hands and I know it. But this can't keep happening, and I'm not having this same conversation again.

Here's what I need from you today:

- Get back out to Desert Palms and decode 9B at least. All 14 if you can.
- Get every code into the sheet, address, unit, and bitting code, before you leave.
- Bring my pinning tray back. It's sitting on the counter in the leasing office and I want it in the van.

Text me when 9B is decoded. Don't tell me it's done until the sheet shows it.

Ray
